title: Temporally discordant chromatin accessibility and DNA demethylation define short- and long-term enhancer regulation during cell fate specification.
authors: Guerin, Lindsey N; Scott, Timothy J; Yap, Jacqueline A; Johansson, Annelie; Puddu, Fabio; Charlesworth, Tom; Yang, Yilin; Simmons, Alan J; Lau, Ken S; Ihrie, Rebecca A; Hodges, Emily
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细胞命运决定中增强子染色质可及性与DNA去甲基化的时间动态，虽用机器学习预测可及性，但核心是表观遗传调控而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与TF-DNA结合机制课题关联较弱。
abstract: Chromatin and DNA modifications mediate the transcriptional activity of lineage-specifying enhancers, but recent work challenges the dogma that joint chromatin accessibility and DNA demethylation are prerequisites for transcription. To understand this paradox, we established a highly resolved timeline of their dynamics during neural progenitor cell differentiation. We discovered that, while complete demethylation appears delayed relative to shorter-lived chromatin changes for thousands of enhancers, DNA demethylation actually initiates with 5-hydroxymethylation before appreciable accessibility and transcription factor occupancy is observed. The extended timeline of DNA demethylation creates temporal discordance appearing as heterogeneity in enhancer regulatory states. Few regions ever gain methylation, and resulting enhancer hypomethylation persists long after chromatin activities have dissipated. We demonstrate that the temporal methylation status of CpGs (mC/hmC/C) predicts past, present, and future chromatin accessibility using machine learning models. Thus, chromatin and DNA methylation collaborate on different timescales to shape short- and long-term enhancer regulation during cell fate specification.
abstract_zh: 染色质和DNA修饰介导了谱系特异性增强子的转录活性，但近期研究挑战了染色质可及性与DNA去甲基化是转录先决条件的传统观点。为理解这一悖论，我们建立了神经祖细胞分化过程中其动态变化的高分辨率时间线。我们发现，尽管对于数千个增强子而言，完全去甲基化相对于较短寿命的染色质变化显得延迟，但DNA去甲基化实际上在可观察到的可及性和转录因子占据之前，就以5-羟甲基化形式启动。DNA去甲基化的延长时间线造成了时间上的不一致性，表现为增强子调控状态的异质性。极少区域获得甲基化，且由此产生的增强子低甲基化在染色质活性消散后仍持续存在。我们利用机器学习模型证明，CpG位点的时间性甲基化状态（mC/hmC/C）能够预测过去、现在和未来的染色质可及性。因此，染色质和DNA甲基化在不同时间尺度上协作，塑造细胞命运决定过程中增强子的短期和长期调控。
